findings.source_quote: Almost without exception, all spoke of hoping to get out of prison one day.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a more natural Arabic rendering of "Almost without exception". Replace "وبالكاد باستثناءٍ، كلهم تحدثوا" with a clearer phrase such as: "تقريبًا دون استثناء، تحدث جميعهم" (preserve surrounding HTML).
findings.translation_quote: وبالكاد باستثناءٍ، كلهم تحدثوا عن الأمل في الخروج من السجن يومًا ما.

findings.source_quote: We do not work for our salvation, for Christ Himself said, “It is finished.”
findings.suggested_fix: The quoted phrase "It is finished." is doctrinally fine but the Arabic «كملت» is slightly terse/colloquial in some registers. If a slightly more formal/standard phrasing is preferred, consider: «قَد أُكْمِلَت» or «قَد أَتَمَّ» while preserving the quotation marks and HTML structure.
findings.translation_quote: نحن لا نعمل من أجل خلاصنا، لأن المسيح نفسه قال: «كملت».
